- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors contributing to the spread of infectious diseases include:

  3. Insect vectors

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Steps taken to prevent and mitigate the spread of infectious diseases include:
  1. Vaccination
  2. Improved sanitation and hygiene
  3. Vector control
  4. Early detection and control
  5. Public education

  3. Asthma
  4. Lead poisoning

  5. Community engagement
